headline: Record demand lifts revenue past prior-quarter legal drag

kpis.label: Net income attributable to Live Nation

summary_short: Revenue rose 9.4% y/y to $7.67B and operating income rose 7.4% y/y to $521.9M in Q2 2026, on record global attendance of 49 million fans (+10%). Diluted EPS of $1.05 compares with a $1.85 diluted loss per share in Q1, which absorbed a one-time $450M legal accrual.
summary_long: Revenue of $7.67B (+9.4% y/y) and GAAP operating income of $521.9M (+7.4% y/y) were driven by record fan attendance (49M, +10%) and broad-based segment growth: Concerts +8%, Ticketing +15%, Sponsorship & Advertising +12%. Adjusted operating income of $817M (+2% y/y, non-GAAP) lagged revenue as Concerts AOI fell 14% on stadium timing and pre-opening costs, offset by Ticketmaster AOI +14% and Sponsorship AOI +13%. Net income was $294.4M (+21.0% y/y); diluted EPS of $1.05 followed a $1.85 diluted loss per share in Q1, which absorbed a $450M governmental-investigations accrual absent in Q2. Cash rose to $9.07B (+28.6% y/y). Full-year capex is now guided to $1.1B, near the low end of the initial range; the company reaffirmed double-digit full-year AOI growth.

drivers.explanation: Record global attendance (49M fans, +10% y/y) and international-market strength drove growth across all three segments; management cites the strongest concert ticket sales pace on record (143M+ tickets sold through mid-July).

Growth was broad-based: Concerts revenue +8%, Ticketing +15% (fee-bearing tickets +8%), Sponsorship & Advertising +12%, with international markets contributing 70-80% of Ticketmaster and Sponsorship AOI growth.

The Q1-to-Q2 swing from an operating loss to a profit is largely explained by the absence of a one-time $450M governmental-investigations-and-litigation accrual that hit Q1's reconciliation table and none of Q2's.
Higher net income and the non-recurrence of Q1's legal accrual explain most of the swing from a $1.85 diluted loss per share to $1.05 diluted earnings per share.
Equity recovered from a Q1 deficit as Q2 net income flowed through and no comparable one-time charge repeated.

Basic vs diluted EPS differ this quarter ($1.06 vs $1.05); diluted is used throughout for consistency with prior summaries.
